nodes.name: Weekly Mon 7AM
nodes.notes: 6.1.1.1. Cadence (weekly, Monday 7AM) is a placeholder matching the pattern already used by Module 2.8 (weekly Mon 8AM) and 2.9 (daily 7AM) - no cadence was specified for this session in the source docs, flagging as configurable rather than a confirmed business rule.

parameters.query:
-- pull all currently active/onboarded accounts to snapshot
SELECT id AS client_id, odoo_lead_id, name, email, status, last_reply_at, last_reply_channel, last_nurture_sent, renewal_date, dunning_attempts
FROM clients_master
WHERE status IN ('Onboarded', 'Active/Onboarded (recurring)', 'Churn Risk', 'Payment Failed')
LIMIT 100;

nodes.name: Get Active Accounts
nodes.notes: LIMIT 100 per §16.3's pagination standard - add a has_more follow-up execution if this ever returns exactly 100.

nodes.notes: REQUIRES SCHEMA CONFIRMATION if communication_events (built in 4.3.3) isn't populated/live yet - falls back to clients_master.last_reply_at in the compute step if this returns nothing.

nodes.name: Usage-Data Pull (Metabase)
nodes.notes: 6.1.1.2. Reuses the exact METABASE_URL/METABASE_API_KEY/METABASE_CLIENT_CARD_ID pattern Module 2.8 already uses for per-client metrics (§10A.2/§10A.3) - not a new tool, not invented. The specific 'usage' metric/card definition inside Metabase itself is whatever 2.8 already queries; confirm the card_id returns a usable numeric usage figure before relying on it here.

nodes.name: MOCK_TICKETING_PROVIDER - Tickets Pull
nodes.notes: 6.1.1.3. DISABLED - clearly labeled mock, per supporting-context §76 (Mocking rule). Support/ticketing tool is explicitly undecided per §0.3 of the master plan (Chatwoot mentioned but not built against). Do not present this as a production integration. Downstream compute node treats a missing/disabled result as ticket_count = null, not 0, so it doesn't silently bias the health score.

nodes.name: Odoo write - x_account_health_score
nodes.notes: 6.1.1.6b. Same execute_kw pattern as 5.1.2. x_account_health_score is a PLACEHOLDER field name, same caveat as 5.1.2 - requires fields_get confirmation before production use. Only fires when odoo_lead_id is present (guard recommended if not already handled upstream).

nodes.name: Log Low-Health Account for Review
nodes.notes: Deliberately reuses workflow_errors as a lightweight review queue rather than sending an automated alert - alerting/escalation logic belongs to 6.4.1 (upsell) / 6.5.x (churn win-back), not this rollup session, so this session doesn't overreach into those sessions' scope.
